svg.text: UniFi network: VLANs and firewall zones
UniFi Network 10.6 on Ahsoka Gateway. Sixteen networks in eight zones; the zone-based firewall decides what crosses between them
VPN client network on the gateway
Tunnel to edge-01, no port forwards
second ring for the five nodes
no inbound port forwards from either WAN
Cloudflare Tunnel is the only public path
VLAN ID; 0 marks the untagged network
Member addresses come from the guest inventory; the VLAN records hold the subnet definitions. Cloudflare has no inbound port forwards: the only public path is the Tunnel that terminates on edge-01.
